name: Her Fallen: A Netori Story
source:
Her Fallen is a visual novel, based on the netori genre. The story develops in the future, where monsters out of portals appeared out of nowhere and destroy the cities. A group of scientist develop a serum that makes some humans capable of fighting those monsters. And, due to their importance, some governments started to denominate those new citizens as "special",  giving them more ways to benefit of the state. 

[Name] is a new student (and special citizen) in the Turon Academy, when he enters his new classroom, he finds himself confronted by a boy and a girl.

You can do good or bad things to the people close to you. It's your choice!

[From [url=https://warrior-novels.itch.io/her-fallen-a-netori-story]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Her Fallen》是一部以夺取他人恋人为主题的视觉小说。故事发生在未来，传送门凭空出现，怪物从中涌出，摧毁城市。一群科学家研发出一种血清，让部分人类拥有对抗怪物的能力。由于他们的重要性，一些政府开始将这些新公民称为“特殊公民”，给予他们更多国家福利。

[Name]是图隆学院的新生，同时也是特殊公民。当他走进新教室时，一名男生与一名女生迎面找上了他。

你可以善待身边的人，也可以对他们作恶。选择权在你！

[摘自[url=https://warrior-novels.itch.io/her-fallen-a-netori-story]itch.io[/url]]
